t: What Does The Name Ayvan Mean?
s: Ayvan is most commonly understood as a phonetic or orthographic variant of Ivan, a Slavic form of the Hebrew Yohanan/Yehochanan, meaning “God is gracious.” Through centuries of linguistic transmission-Hebrew to Greek Ioannes, to Latin Iohannes, to Old Church Slavonic Ioan-the name spread widely, yielding Ivan across Slavic languages.
